topic: North Field West (NFW) onshore EPC contract award
wiki_text: On 25 February 2026, QatarEnergy awarded the engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contract for the onshore plant of the North Field West (NFW) project to a joint venture of Technip Energies, Consolidated Contractors Company (CCC) and Gulf Asia Contractor (GAC). The scope covers two LNG mega-trains with a combined capacity of 16 mtpa, plus gas treatment, NGL recovery, helium extraction and a 1.1 mtpa carbon-capture-and-sequestration facility. First LNG cargo is targeted for the end of 2031. NFW lifts Qatar's planned LNG capacity from 126 mtpa (after NFE+NFS) to 142 mtpa.
